merchantId.description: Gets the merchant id (Edge merchant id is configured in Nexus).

merchantReference.description:
Gets the merchant reference for this authorization.
Edge does not always supply one; if missing, the handler will default it.

amount.description: Gets the order amount. Nullable to support zero/no-amount orders.

redirectCancelUrl.description: Gets the url that the user will be redirected to if they cancel the checkout.

redirectConfirmUrl.description: Gets the url that the user will be redirected to after they have completed the checkout.

canLink.description: When true, Zip will return a refresh token to the merchant during the callback so the user can be linked across sessions.

rememberMeKey.description: Gets the RememberMeKey used to fetch a refresh token from FEO.

publicKey.description:
Gets the merchant's public key used by the frontend to encrypt the exit payload
(card details and refresh token) before posting back to the redirect confirm URL.

skipEstimate.description: When true, the frontend will not prompt the customer for an order amount.
